Full-stack Engineer (Middle)

Northwind Labs is a small product studio working on logistics software. We are hiring a middle full-stack engineer to join a team of six.

Work format: hybrid, 3 days per week in our Kyiv office.

You will:
- Build features in React and Next.js
- Design REST APIs in Node.js with NestJS
- Work with PostgreSQL and write migrations

You have:
- 3 years of commercial experience
- Good knowledge of TypeScript
- Docker basics
- Experience with Jest

We offer a competitive salary, health insurance and a learning budget.
